adoption_rule: adopt when the mean inner accuracy improves on at least 5 of 7 datasets and no dataset worsens by more than 1 percentage point; not_applicable when fewer than 5 datasets are scored; otherwise reject
aggregation: mean inner-validation accuracy over outer folds x inner folds x fitting seeds of the outer repeat; paired changes are per-unit differences against the reference

bridge_source.directory: supplied by --bridge-source at pilot and prepare and recorded in manifest.json
bridge_source.selected_configuration: results/<dataset>__arrowflow_full__r<repeat>f<fold>.json selection block, verified through run_bridge.selection_record and resolved through run_bridge.planned_job from the outer training partition; outer-test numbers are not copied into the laboratory

evidence: inner-fold development only; no outer test fold is scored; never manuscript evidence

permlvq.budget: iterations, batch_size and learning_rate of the bridge-selected configuration; p_correct and repulsion below; the fitting seed of the unit; prototypes_per_class (prototype_grid) and, for the plurality and borda readouts, the readout size k (readout_k_grid) are selected jointly one level deeper on the selection splits of the inner training partition
permlvq.comparison: knn_hidden mean inner accuracy from readouts_summary.json in the same output directory when present and produced from the same bridge selections
permlvq.representation: view-0 encodings (target-aware OrdinalEncoder.transform of the fitted single view) as inverse positions; the permutation LVQ stack replaces the ArrowFlow network on the same encodings, seeds and budget
permlvq.update: arrowflow.permlvq.PermutationLVQ: labeled permutation prototypes; footrule distances; a sample is accepted when the nearest prototype has the wrong label or with probability p_correct; accepted samples vote learning_rate for the nearest same-label prototype toward the sample and, with repulsion, for the nearest other-label prototype toward the reversed sample; votes accumulate in ArrowFlow's per-prototype V x V matrix (identity prior of weight prior_weight, 1 unless the variant says otherwise) and every voted-on prototype is reordered after the batch by the aggregation rule

variant_definitions.lvq1_borda_borda: one layer; Borda aggregation; Borda readout (score k-j for the j-th nearest prototype, lowest label on ties); prototypes_per_class and k selected jointly
variant_definitions.lvq1_borda_nearest: one layer; Borda aggregation; label of the nearest prototype; prototypes_per_class selected
variant_definitions.lvq1_borda_plurality: one layer; Borda aggregation (row means, ties by item ID; identity prior weight 1); plurality among the k nearest prototypes (lowest label on ties); prototypes_per_class and k selected jointly
variant_definitions.lvq1_median_plurality: one layer; footrule-median aggregation (minimum-cost assignment, Dwork et al. 2001) with the identity prior of weight 1 (the literal brief: an item moves only when the vote mass on it exceeds 1); plurality readout; prototypes_per_class and k selected jointly
variant_definitions.lvq1_median_priorlr_plurality: one layer; footrule-median aggregation with prior_weight = learning_rate (one consistent vote ties the prior, two consistent votes move an item); plurality readout; prototypes_per_class and k selected jointly
variant_definitions.lvq2_borda_plurality: two layers with the same prototypes_per_class, the second fitted on the first layer's frozen prototype ranking; Borda aggregation; plurality readout; prototypes_per_class and k selected jointly
variant_definitions.output_rule: reference: the fitted single view predicts with its own output rule

readout_definitions.borda1: comparisons.BordaClassifier on the hidden positions (one Borda prototype per class); no hyperparameter
readout_definitions.knn_hidden: comparisons.StableFootruleKNN(input_kind=positions) on the hidden positions; n_neighbors x weights chosen on the selection splits of the inner training partition
readout_definitions.kproto_borda: arrowflow.readouts.KPrototypeBorda on the hidden positions; k chosen on the selection splits of the inner training partition; k-means seeded by the fitting seed
readout_definitions.output_rule: reference: the fitted single view predicts with its own output rule

readouts.representation: ArrowFlowEstimator.transform_orders: inverse positions of the final hidden ranking

model: bridge-selected configuration of each outer fold, resolved from the outer training partition (run_bridge.planned_job), n_views=1 (view 0: target-aware encoding), fitted on the inner training partition with the selected validation_ratio
pilot: one cell per requested dataset (first outer fold of the outer repeat, inner fold 0, first fit seed) evaluated in a single process under the execution lock; pilot.json records the cell seconds and the projection planned_cells x mean_cell_seconds (serial hours), divided by the worker count for the ideal wall-clock; the readouts and permlvq commands refuse --workers > 1 without a pilot.json of their family in the laboratory root unless --skip-pilot-check is passed

selection.rule: hyperparameters chosen on up to `folds` stratified splits of the inner training partition (split seed derived from `seed`, the dataset and the folds); mean accuracy, ties by lowest canonical config_id; the scored inner validation fold never enters a selection and no outer test fold is touched

status: development laboratory; not frozen; adoption verdicts are read at gate G3 and adopted variants are re-evaluated once on the outer folds under a separate protocol
